title: 教育制度論(夏期集中講義)
subtitle: Principles of Educational System

keywords: Educational Reform 2.System of Education 3.Administration of Education 4.Organization of Education 5.Human Rights of Children
educationalGoal: When we talk about education, we often focus on the educational activities of students and teachers, but we don't focus on the system of education. In this course, we will take up the laws and regulations related to the education. We will deepen our understanding of the current situation and structure, as well as consider its reform trends.
advice: In this course, students will discuss on the law and regulations as below. Especially we will focus on the laws and regulations that have influenced the administration and policy formation related to school education, and consider their use in specific cases. 1. The laws and regulations of the basics of education 2. The laws and regulations of educational system 3. The laws and regulations of students, teachers, and parents 4. The laws and regulations of educational activities 5. The laws and regulations of educational administration
books: Sumiko Ichikawa, Masaaki Katsuno, et al.(2020) Kyouiku Syou-Roppou, Gakuyou-Shobou.
requiredKnowledge: Aiming to obtain a Japanese teacher's license

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider educational system and organization and answer the questions.

Be able to explain the problems about the educational regulations and their solutions.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
 ※学習課題の時間欄には、指定された学習課題に要する標準的な時間を記載してあります。日々の自学自習時間全体としては、各授業に応じた時間(例えば2単位科目の場合、予習2時間・復習2時間/週)を取るよう努めてください。詳しくは教員の指導に従って下さい。     授業明細   回数 学習内容 授業の運営方法 学習課題(予習・復習) 時間:分※     1  ●Course introduction ●Discussion: what are the laws and regulations of education? ●Self-reflection Lecture and Q&A Discussion ●Understand the syllabus of this course ●Review the disc
